name: KETOPROFEN / PARACETAMOL 100/300MG 12 TABLETS DOLFORT-DE
description: Combining ketoprofen and paracetamol is possible and may be more effective at relieving pain than using each medication separately. The analgesic effect of this combination can be synergistic, meaning both drugs enhance each other’s action. Key aspects of this combination: Efficacy: In several studies, the combination of ketoprofen (a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug, or NSAID) and paracetamol has demonstrated better analgesia and a faster onset of action for acute pain (such as dental or postoperative pain). If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
